# Sownmark Solutions

> India's leading full-service digital marketing and custom software agency.

## Services Offered
- [Digital Marketing](https://sownmark.com/services/digital-marketing): Full-funnel digital marketing services, performance advertising, and growth strategy.
- [SEO + GEO + AEO](https://sownmark.com/services/seo): Getting brands cited by traditional engines and generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini).
- [Generative Engine Optimisation](https://sownmark.com/services/generative-engine-optimisation): Optimising entities and content so AI assistants cite your brand.
- [Answer Engine Optimisation](https://sownmark.com/services/answer-engine-optimisation): Featured snippets, voice search and Google AI Overviews.
- [Display Advertising](https://sownmark.com/services/display-advertising): Programmatic advertising, GDN placement, high-converting banner and video ad creation.
- [Social Media Management](https://sownmark.com/services/social-media-management): Organic social growth, content strategy, brand community engagement.
- [Influencer Marketing](https://sownmark.com/services/influencer-marketing): Vetted creator network for brand trust and conversions.
- [Web Development](https://sownmark.com/services/web-development): Landing pages, corporate sites and e-commerce portals.
- [Software Development](https://sownmark.com/services/software-development): React, Next.js, Node.js, SaaS development, CRM & ERP custom architecture.
- [Hiring Solutions](https://sownmark.com/services/hiring-solutions): Tech and marketing talent recruitment and staffing.
